beta.title: Beta Version
beta.whatIsBetaDescription: SuperTierMaker is currently in beta version, which means we are constantly improving and enhancing the platform based on user feedback. This version allows you to test all available features while we continue developing new features and refining the experience.
beta.whyBeta: Why did we release a beta version?
beta.whyBetaTitle: Why did we release a beta version?
beta.whyBetaDescription: We decided to release this beta version to:

whyBetaReasons.collectFeedback: Collect valuable feedback: Your opinion is essential to improve the platform
whyBetaReasons.testRealConditions: Test in real conditions: Allowing real users to use the system helps identify problems and improvement opportunities
whyBetaReasons.developFeatures: Develop features based on needs: We learn which features are most important to you
whyBetaReasons.ensureStability: Ensure stability: Identify and fix bugs before the final version
whyBetaReasons.optimizeExperience: Optimize the experience: Improve usability based on real usage

whatToExpectItems.completeFeatures: Complete features: All main features are available and functional
whatToExpectItems.continuousImprovements: Continuous improvements: We regularly add new features and fix problems
whatToExpectItems.possibleInstabilities: Possible instabilities: Some bugs or changes may occur while we refine the system
whatToExpectItems.activeSupport: Active support: We are always working to resolve problems quickly
whatToExpectItems.newFeatures: New features: You will be one of the first to try new features

beta.howToHelpDescription: Your participation is fundamental to the platform's success:

howToHelpItems.usePlatform: Use the platform: Explore all features and create your templates and tier lists
howToHelpItems.reportProblems: Report problems: If you find bugs or unexpected behavior, contact us
howToHelpItems.shareFeedback: Share feedback: Your opinion on what works well and what can be improved is very valuable
howToHelpItems.bePatient: Be patient: We are working hard to make the experience better and better

beta.whenFinal: When will the final version be?
beta.whenFinalTitle: When will the final version be?
beta.whenFinalDescription: We don't have a specific date for the final version launch. We are focused on creating the best possible experience based on user feedback. When we feel that the platform is stable, polished and meets user needs, we will transition to the final version. Until then, we will continue to improve and add features based on your feedback.
beta.gratitudeDescription: We thank you for being part of this journey and for helping us build a better platform. Your support and feedback are essential to SuperTierMaker's success!

donation.title: Support SuperTierMaker
donation.description: SuperTierMaker is free for everyone. If you enjoy the platform and want to help keep it running (hosting, infrastructure, and development) consider making a voluntary donation.
donation.note: Donations do not unlock extra features. They simply support the project.
donation.onceHint: Suggested R$ 1.00 — you can change the amount at checkout.
